queries.rationale: Locate direct prior work on LLMs producing network configs, intent-driven translation, and evaluation of correctness in NetOps contexts.

queries.query: network configuration verification OR formal verification network configs OR "Batfish" OR "Header Space Analysis" OR NetKAT
queries.rationale: Survey deterministic and formal validators used to verify correctness and properties of network configurations to serve as validators or baselines.

queries.rationale: Find architectures and experiments that combine generation with validation and repair loops, relevant for mitigations and agentic workflows.

queries.rationale: Identify methods where LLMs call external tools, verifiers, or retrieval systems to reduce hallucination and increase operational correctness.

queries.rationale: Capture prior work on agentic or autonomous agents applied to network operations and orchestration frameworks integrating LLMs.

queries.rationale: Map documented failure modes when LLMs perform operational/mission-critical tasks to inform threat models and experimental perturbations.

queries.rationale: Survey studies and operational practices integrating human operators with automated suggestions, approvals, and audit trails.

queries.rationale: Compile candidate metrics and measurement protocols suitable for quantifying operational trustworthiness of LLM-driven NetOps.

queries.rationale: Survey analogous work in other safety-critical domains to borrow evaluation methods, mitigations, and threat models.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers (conferences, journals) and reputable preprints (arXiv) that present methods, experiments, or benchmarks relevant to LLMs/NetOps.
Tool, benchmark, or dataset documentation and official repositories (GitHub) with reproducible artifacts or code.
Industry whitepapers, vendor technical documentation, and case studies that provide operational detail (Cisco, Juniper, etc.).
Standards, RFCs, and IETF/IETF-draft material relevant to network configuration and management (e.g., YANG, intent frameworks).
Works published from 2015–2026 with emphasis on 2020–2026 for LLM-specific advances.
Materials in English with sufficient methodological detail to assess applicability, metrics, or reproduction.
exclusion_criteria: Pure marketing materials or vendor claims without technical evidence or reproducible artifacts.
Opinion pieces, short blog posts, or news articles lacking technical detail unless they link to primary technical sources.
Proprietary internal reports or datasets not publicly accessible and without reproducible artifacts.
Works unrelated to operational network configuration, validation, or automation (e.g., purely conversational LLM demos without NetOps relevance).
Non-English works unless an English translation or sufficient summary is available.
date_rationale: Cover the foundational network verification and automation literature from ~2015 onward while prioritizing 2020–2026 for LLM- and agentic-specific methods, to ensure capture of recent rapid advances relevant to CNSM 2026.
